title: Best Work Pants (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected products were taken from the seven pairs tested by Carl Murawski (source 1), the work‑pants list from HiConsumption (source 3), and the Rugged Flex review from 1620USA (source 4). The best pick was the one that appeared in the most sources and had the highest strength figures.
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so no price comparison is made.
